info.title: Ping
info.description: Ping runs AI support bots for websites. Memora retrieves the passages (retrieval only); Ping reasons over them and writes every answer through the VizhiOps LLM gateway.

post.description:
Sign in with a Google ID token. The first sign-in creates the account
and its organization.

Drop the cookie. There is no server-side session: the JWT stays valid
until it expires for anyone holding a copy.

The full transcript. Opening it marks the conversation read.

get.description: Polled by an open transcript: messages newer than `after` and the status.

Appearance and online state. Loading this marks the domain as seen,
which is what the install check reports.

post.description:
Ask a question. With `stream: true` the reply arrives as server-sent
events: `delta` events with text, then a `done` event with the message.
`Pingie.identify({email, name})`: attribute the chat to a known user.

The visitor asked for a person. `waiting` when an agent is online,
otherwise `unavailable` and the next message is checked for an email.

get.description:
Polled while a person is handling the chat: agent and system messages
newer than `after`, plus who is answering.
